text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release=2026.03.17-rc4 to cluster=prod-eu :rocket:
incident-bot: Paging sam (SRE) - potential canary failures detected (error rate > 3% on /generate) :rotating_light:
sam (SRE): on it, joining call. hooking into logs now
elaine (Eng): I see elevated tail latency and a few 500s from model-serving pods 10-12
kevin (Deploy): Canary is at 8% traffic. Are automated rollbacks enabled?
sam (SRE): yes, but the auto-rollback job is throttled by a cooldown window; we need manual confirmation to speed it up
ops-bot: alert: canary_error_rate=4.6% (5m avg), cpu spike on node gpu-07
elaine (Eng): logs show OOM in worker-inference->"kv_cache_allocate":
```
ERROR inference: out of memory allocating 1024MB at kv_cache.c:412
```
kevin (Deploy): that matches a bad kernel selection introduced in the build. recommend kill-switch flip and drain canary
sam (SRE): agreed. initiating manual rollback procedure. @deploy-bot please pause traffic shift and mark canary quarantined
deploy-bot: Pausing traffic shift... paused. Canary target set to 0%
kevin (Deploy): initiating manual rollback to previous image tag=2026.03.10-stable on canary pool
elaine (Eng): running smoke tests against rollback target endpoints
cs-team: we're seeing intermittent 502s from EU customers; holding customer comms until we know scope
sam (SRE): commands for validation I ran:
```
# check canary pods
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l roll=canary -o wide
# tail logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l roll=canary -c inference --tail=200
# quick curl health
curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://eu.api.redwood.ai/health
```
kevin (Deploy): rollback job started (job-id: rb-20260317-01). watching rollout status
ops-bot: rollback job rb-20260317-01: 1/3 pods updated, draining traffic from old canary instances
elaine (Eng): after first update, 503s dropped but latency still high for long seqs — confirming KV cache config reverted correctly
sam (SRE): can everyone run a quick workload check against canary-replay set=smoke-5k? I want p95 < 300ms
elaine (Eng): smoke-5k run results: p50 120ms, p95 280ms, error 0.2% :+1:
cs-team: passing this to support: EU customer impact seems to be reduced, still following up on logged cases
kevin (Deploy): rollback job completed successfully. marking release=2026.03.17-rc4 as rolled back in release registry
incident-bot: Incident updated: manual rollback executed; severity downgraded to SEV2 — continuing verification
sam (SRE): running final checks: global routing back to baseline, canary traffic set to 0, rolling metrics look stable for 10m
ops-bot: node gpu-07 shows reclaimed memory, no OOMs in last 5m
elaine (Eng): open action: revert kernel selection change from PR #4521 and add a canary-only stress test to catch KV cache growth
kevin (Deploy): I'll coordinate the PR revert and add a gated rollout to avoid auto-promote next time
cs-team: preparing a brief to send to impacted EU customers: note rollback, reduced errors, apology, and mitigation steps
sam (SRE): oncall handoff: I'll keep watch for 30 more mins then hand to daily oncall. Thanks all. :handshake:
deploy-bot: Canary traffic is 0%. Closure checklist:
- rollback complete
- smoke tests passing
- customer-impact tracked
- follow-up PR filed (#4528)
elaine (Eng): filing the PR now, linking tests and metrics artifacts
kevin (Deploy): marking incident resolved in tracker after 30m observation window
sam (SRE): closing thread once observation window passes. Good coordination everyone. :tada:
